$schema_note: Worker W2 - Task B (starred repositories, spec section 76). See pkos/00-discovery/W2-github-report.md for full narrative and LIMITATIONS.
status_meaning: Zero records could be retrieved. This is NOT a rate-limit exhaustion (budget was untouched) and NOT an empty result (account may well have stars) - it is a categorical access block at the network-proxy layer, confirmed session-wide. Do not treat total_captured=0 as evidence the account has no stars.

accounts_attempted.api_verification_blocked_reason: GET /users/mynewopportunities returned HTTP 403 from the session proxy before reaching GitHub

total_existing_per_account: unknown - could not be determined, GitHub never returned a payload

request_attempted.response_body: {"message":"This GitHub API path is not available: sessions are bound to their configured repositories. Use repository-scoped endpoints (repos/{owner}/{repo}/...).","documentation_url":"https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/github-actions"}
request_attempted.evidence_it_never_reached_github: response carried no X-RateLimit-* headers, and a fresh GET https://api.github.com/rate_limit taken immediately after showed used=0/limit=15000 - identical to before any blocked calls were made

why_this_endpoint_is_categorically_block: The session's outbound proxy only permits GitHub REST paths matching repos/{owner}/{repo}/... for repositories explicitly enabled for this session (via an 'add_repo' mechanism not present in this worker's toolset). GET /users/{user}/starred is not a repos/{owner}/{repo}/... path, so no amount of per-repo enabling would unlock it - it is out of scope for this proxy's design entirely, not merely 'not yet granted'.
alternative_local_evidence_search_result: Searched the entire mounted 'AutoMSP BOS Claude Project' folder for any locally-cached export of GitHub stars (CSV/JSON exports, browser bookmark exports, etc.). None found. One adjacent document, AutoMSP_Skills_Inventory_and_OSS_Landscape.md, ranks OSS projects by star/fork counts, but it is an external market-landscape research survey (dated 2026-09-06, framed explicitly as 'what could you build this with' rather than 'what has this account starred') - it is NOT the user's personal starred-repo list and must not be substituted for Task B data.
deferred_enrichment_not_attempted: README bodies for individual starred repos (out of scope even if the endpoint had worked, per instructions)
remediation_for_next_run: A worker/session with either (a) a genuinely unauthenticated network path to api.github.com (bypassing this proxy), or (b) the 'add_repo'-equivalent capability to enable the target user's public data endpoints, would be required to complete this task. Neither was available to W2.
